about: A Guide entry on the eight trigrams, queued overnight (the user, 2026-10-01: 'please queue up a few more shorts/and ideas'). Same look and voice as guide-wangbi. Draft 2: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-guide-trigrams.md), except 63 is named Already Across, as in the converged guide-64 entry.

voice.name: hitchiker's guide v1
voice.note: the user's designed Guide voice ('love it'); plain, even pace, no emphasis announcing the jokes

narration.text: The I-Ching. A book of situations. Each six-line figure has two three-line halves, called trigrams.
narration.picture: THE I-CHING types; one six-line figure separates into two halves, each labelled TRIGRAM.

narration.text: There are eight: every combination of solid and broken lines.
narration.picture: A solid and a broken line, labelled SOLID and BROKEN; eight trigrams in a still grid; 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.

narration.text: One commentary lists their qualities: heaven, strong. Earth, yielding. Thunder, moving. Wind, entering.
narration.picture: 說卦 DISCUSSION OF THE TRIGRAMS; four cards: 乾 HEAVEN / STRONG, 坤 EARTH / YIELDING, 震 THUNDER / MOVING, 巽 WIND / ENTERING.

narration.text: Water, danger. Fire, clinging. Mountain, stopping. Lake, joy.
narration.picture: The other four: 坎 WATER / DANGER, 離 FIRE / CLINGING, 艮 MOUNTAIN / STOPPING, 兌 LAKE / JOY.

narration.text: It also lists animals: horse, ox, dragon, chicken, pig, pheasant, dog, sheep.
narration.picture: The grid again; simple animal outlines beside their trigrams as named; the pheasant with a long tail; the chicken the same size as the rest.

narration.text: Fire below water: Already Across. The task: guard against trouble.
narration.picture: Fire stacks below water; 63 既濟 ALREADY ACROSS, then GUARD AGAINST TROUBLE.

narration.text: Recommended for: reading figures in halves. Not recommended for: arguing with the chicken.
narration.picture: SUMMARY, tick and cross; the same chicken outline beside the second row, still.

sources.shuogua: 說卦 (Discussion of the Trigrams, one of the Ten Wings): 乾健也，坤順也，震動也，巽入也，坎陷也，離麗也，艮止也，兌說也; 乾為馬，坤為牛，震為龍，巽為雞，坎為豕，離為雉，艮為狗，兌為羊. ~/projects/chinese-classics-reference/zhouyi-zhushu/text/67-shuogua-zhuan.md (lines 268-270).
